dataset.name: Feedzai BAF Base
dataset.kind: synthetic account-opening data; not real card/UPI transactions
dataset.attribution: Sergio Jesus, Jose Pombal, Duarte Alves, Andre Cruz, Pedro Saleiro, Rita P. Ribeiro, Joao Gama, Pedro Bizarro; Feedzai BAF, NeurIPS 2022

protocol.population: BAF Base synthetic, derived from anonymized real data
protocol.label_policy: provided retrospective labels; actual delay unknown
protocol.search_budget: 3 predeclared estimators per month; no random hyperparameter search

temporal_summary.interpretation: Three forward-period observations, not a confidence interval or independent replications. Training windows overlap.

financial_outcomes.reason: Observed loss, recovery, review expense, currency and closed-outcome records are required. Transaction exposure is not a substitute.

published_comparison.meaning: Matching asserted protocol fields only; not independent verification of dataset authenticity or published-score reproduction.

limits: Synthetic account-opening task does not validate real card/UPI or current Indian bank performance.
Month is the only time resolution. Original entities, label availability and generation provenance remain outside this experiment.
Age is excluded from prediction, not proof of fairness; other features can act as proxies.
Age-group Wilson intervals assume independent applications. No demographic fairness claim applies to ULB.
One test-month cluster per fold is insufficient for dependence-aware AP confidence intervals; no such interval is reported.
Source precomputed velocities are supplied synthetic features; their original point-in-time production provenance is not independently verified.

ulb_dependence_guard.status: insufficient independent clusters; no interval reported
